edition.title: Pillowfort: An MLS-Based Protocol for Ephemeral Rooms
changes: Specify immediate fencing and offer creation in M4 and exercise both authenticated reconnect orders, delayed old closure, choice deadlines, and restart witnesses.
Recover a committed offer before its first delivery through a persisted wakeup and authenticated same-device replay; do not extend its authorization.
Defer blocked participant work until independent relay progress; retain explicit refusal and encrypted chat after the next candidate accepts.
Publish all model logs, the nine browser scenarios, two isolated workerd fault scenarios, and separate production checks.

source.archiveExclusion: Only the earlier paper/ publication subtree is omitted. Runtime, test, lockfile and model inputs remain.

promptSuccession.scope: Apply to the extracted baseline archive from its root. The extracted, patched tree matches every non-paper Git blob and executable mode of the new revision.

source.archiveScope: Historical archive and excerpts; apply qualification.sourcePatch for the edition 8 implementation, test sources and models.

qualification.scope: Apply the single cumulative qualification patch to the extracted baseline. Every non-paper Git blob and executable bit matched.

models.scope: Finite coordination safety abstraction; no cryptographic proof, deadlock freedom, fairness or unbounded liveness claim.

shutdown.regression: persists explicit retirement after a signed succession policy was installed
shutdown.beforeFailure: invalid secure relay state at export; production close-room returned persistence-failed
shutdown.after: Retired-state export/import and exact retry succeed; production terminal screen appears and the composer is unavailable.

retainedBrowserFaults.interpretation: Earlier same-identity successor recovery, permanent-loss retirement and peer storage-failure executions are retained with their original revision attribution.

retainedLightLoadLatency.method: UI submit to host DOM application; one outstanding message; 500 ms quiet interval after delivery outside each sample; nearest-rank quantiles.
retainedLightLoadLatency.interpretation: Light-load latency only. Raw achieved paced-rate fields are preserved in original JSON for provenance and are not presented as capacity evidence.

courtJester.currentReleaseChecks: Historical production checks only; see PRODUCTION_DEPLOYMENT.json
courtJester.verdict: Retained release-scope calls are inconclusive: relay export coverage 10/11, test files select no required exported surfaces, runner has no analyzable functions. No blanket pass is claimed. Exact commands and outputs are retained.

publicationArtifacts.visualVerification: Chromium rendered all three documents and loaded every illustration. Verified page numbers and bounds on every PDF page; inspected the introduction and evaluation spread. The evidence and latency tables, including the original measurement caveat, fit on page 9.

previousEditionImplementation.description: Retained checks at the published edition 2 source. Commands and counts are historical.

recoveryFaults.environment: Local production browser bundle; real MLS, WebSockets, IndexedDB, three isolated browser profiles and the unmodified disconnect grace.
recoveryFaults.failureRecordScope: Negative tests and pre-fix executions during development, not results on the final source. Browser records contain frame categories, not plaintext or invitations. Focused unit failure logs normalize the local test-root path and loopback port.
recoveryFaults.outcome: After replacement, ordinary sends wait for the current completion ACK. Roster absence and lifecycle notices do not discharge outstanding retirement work. An observer that processed the Remove before close verifies its duplicate and recovers.

localReleaseGate.scope: App and Worker typechecks, ordinary tests, isolated security suites, OpenMLS artifact check, client build and agent catalog.

edition3Models.scope: Finite coordination safety abstraction; no cryptographic proof, deadlock freedom, fairness or unbounded liveness claim.
edition3Models.excludedConcretePath: Concrete FIFO marker identities, exact retirement-control serialization, browser message-close dispatch and explicit room retirement are not modeled.
edition3Models.sourceComparison: Bundled model sources verified byte-for-byte against the pinned source archive.

currentImplementation.priorFailuresAndLimits: See qualificationRecord; scheduled forced close is a positive control, not spontaneous failure detection.

production.scope: Normal use of two verification-owned rooms in production. No eviction, network cuts or changes to third-party rooms. Browser time is a single explicit close-to-visible-offer observation, not a network failure bound.

evidenceLimits: Honest serialized relay and correct endpoint cryptography assumed in the models; no TLA+-to-TypeScript refinement or independent security audit.
Finite participants, operation tokens and deadline regions; 12/16-step composed prefixes. No unbounded fairness or availability guarantee.
Local workerd eviction retained sockets and durable storage. This does not establish disk power-loss recovery or recovery after permanent identity loss.
Loopback blackhole dropped WebSocket bytes while TCP endpoints acknowledged locally; no hard failure detector, WAN latency or offline agent-wakeup claim.
No independent audit or new performance benchmark. Historical latency and release observations retain their original attribution.
